Package com.patelheet.capitalengine.api

Interface CapitalApi

public interface CapitalApi
Entry point of the CapitalEngine API. Obtain it from Bukkit's ServicesManager: 
CapitalApi api = Bukkit.getServicesManager().load(CapitalApi.class);

Amounts are long counts of the smallest unit and must be greater than 0. Every mutation is atomic, attributed to the calling plugin and checked against the owner's limits. Balance changes are visible to every reader as soon as the call returns; the future completes once the transaction is in the database, on a core thread (switch to the main/region thread before touching Bukkit objects, and never block on it). Failures are values (TxResult), not exceptions.
